# Third-party notices

SDA Vision's code retains its MIT licence. Dependencies, font files and example
media have their own terms. Exact notices from the pinned frontend packages are
retained in `frontend/`; the inventory includes production-marked transitive
packages, including build/type packages that may not appear in browser bundles.
`https@1.0.0` contains only package metadata (no code); its declared ISC label is
recorded without inventing a copyright notice. The `isarray` notice is in its
original README. Dual-licensed packages retain their supplied licence texts.

Noto Sans and the complete-text Noto Sans Math export fallback use the supplied
SIL Open Font License. Noto Sans Math is from the official notofonts/noto-fonts
archive, blob 268f9ec650e2adcb63c806a9a8ffc224c4bd06f9. Adobe's sample licence applies
to the matching C2PA example, not to other example media. See the example credits.
The Python environment retains installed packages' own notices; binary wheels,
including PDFium, must keep their bundled dependency licences when redistributed.
